# Memories and Caches

## Concepts

Memory organization, locality, cache policies, address translation, and memory hierarchy tradeoffs.

## Implementation

Study SystemVerilog memory interfaces and cache structures in a RISC-V SoC.

## Hands-on Experiments

Compare memory access patterns and cache configurations using reproducible workloads.

For each experiment, record the tool versions, design configuration, commands, inputs, expected results, and observed results.
